name: African Lion
desc: The lion is a strong wild cat that lives in grassy savannas in Africa. Lions live together in family groups called prides. Male lions have a thick mane of hair around their heads, and their loud roar can be heard far away.

name: African Elephant
desc: The elephant is the largest land animal on Earth. It uses its long trunk to breathe, drink water, and pick up sweet leaves from tall trees. Elephants have big ears that help keep their bodies cool in the hot sun.

name: Giraffe
desc: The giraffe is the tallest animal in the world with a very long neck and spotted coat. Its long purple tongue helps it eat fresh leaves at the top of acacia trees. Baby giraffes can stand up and walk just one hour after they are born.

name: Bengal Tiger
desc: The tiger is the biggest wild cat in Asia with bright orange fur and dark black stripes. Every tiger has a unique stripe pattern, just like human fingerprints. Unlike most cats, tigers love to swim in cool forest rivers.

name: Giant Panda
desc: The giant panda is a gentle bear with black and white fur that lives in mountain bamboo forests. Pandas spend up to twelve hours every day eating crunchy green bamboo shoots. They are wonderful climbers and love resting in trees.

name: Toco Toucan
desc: The toucan is a colorful rainforest bird famous for its huge bright orange beak. Even though its beak looks very heavy, it is actually light and hollow inside. Toucans use their beaks to reach sweet tropical fruits on thin branches.

name: Bottlenose Dolphin
desc: Dolphins are smart and playful marine mammals that swim in blue oceans around the world. They talk to each other using special clicks, whistles, and body jumps. Dolphins breathe air through a blowhole on the top of their heads.

name: Green Sea Turtle
desc: The green sea turtle has a smooth shell and strong flippers that work like paddles in the ocean. Sea turtles can travel thousands of miles across the sea to lay their eggs on warm sandy beaches. They love eating sea grass and underwater algae.

name: Blue Whale
desc: The blue whale is the largest animal that has ever lived on our planet. Its heart is as big as a small car, and its gentle songs can travel deep through the ocean. Blue whales eat tiny shrimp called krill every single day.

name: Polar Bear
desc: The polar bear lives on the icy Arctic snow and freezing ocean waters. It has a thick layer of fat and warm white fur to protect it from the cold wind. Polar bears have giant paws that help them swim smoothly between ice blocks.

name: Emperor Penguin
desc: The emperor penguin is a flightless bird that wears a black and white tuxedo coat. Instead of flying in the sky, penguins use their wings like flippers to dive deep into icy water for fish. They huddle closely together to stay warm in winter storms.

name: Arctic Fox
desc: The arctic fox is a clever small fox with a fluffy tail that wraps around its body like a warm blanket. Its fur changes color from brown in summer to pure white in winter to hide in the snow. It has amazing hearing to find food under the ice.
